information.name: backup-sync-google-drive
information.description: Synchronizes UNMS backups to a Google Drive Shared Drive via a Workspace service account.
information.author: KIZA Internet

configuration.label: UNMS API token
configuration.description: You can create a UNMS API token in Network -> Settings -> Users. Must belong to a Super Admin user - the backups endpoint this plugin reads from is restricted to Super Admins.

configuration.label: Google service account JSON key
configuration.description: Paste the full contents of the service account's JSON key file (Google Cloud Console -> IAM & Admin -> Service Accounts -> Keys). The service account must be added as a member of the target Shared Drive.

configuration.label: Google Shared Drive ID
configuration.description: The target Shared Drive's ID (from its URL: drive.google.com/drive/folders/<id> when viewing the Shared Drive's root).

configuration.label: Backup folder name
configuration.description: Folder created/used at the root of the Shared Drive to hold backups. Defaults to "UISP Backups" if left blank.
